title: PGSimCity - How PostgreSQL Works
ai_summary:
• PostgreSQL is a popular open-source relational database management system.
• It uses SQL queries for structured data management and retrieval.
• PGSimCity offers a simulation-based interface to explore PostgreSQL concepts.
student_angle: Learn PostgreSQL to boost your database knowledge and skills in data science, a highly in-demand field.

title: Decker, a platform that builds on the legacy of Hypercard and classic macOS
ai_summary:
• Decker is a new platform inspired by Hypercard, a classic 80s-90s tool for creating interactive digital cards.
• It aims to bring back some of the intuitive design elements from classic macOS and Hypercard.
• Decker lets users create interactive, web-like cards using a simple drag-and-drop interface.
student_angle: Worth considering for UI/UX design internships if you enjoy retro-inspired design.

title: Scriptc by Vercel: TypeScript-to-Native compiler, no JavaScript engine in binary
ai_summary:
• Scriptc by Vercel is a TypeScript-to-Native compiler that compiles TypeScript code to native binary without relying on JavaScript engine.
• This means developers can write and compile TypeScript code for native execution without JavaScript runtime dependency.
• Vercel claims this approach enhances performance, security, and reliability for enterprise-grade applications.
student_angle: Study Scriptc to learn a TypeScript native compilation option offering performance and security benefits.

title: French firefighters face 'pyrocumulonimbus' for first time
ai_summary:

title: US citizen charged after GrapheneOS phone wipes during airport search
ai_summary:
